items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: See, Harry was running there. I was waiting there for him a long time.

ctx.x: I left the Hominé, because he told us to go out there and try to build a place. I went out there, to try to build a place, and the police was going fine. Mm-hm. And the cops started coming around, and the people got scared, man. How about the- I went back to the club, then we left from there, went back to Tulane there, and, yeah. Back to Tulane there, caught, and there, but on this side of the band, right across the ball club. See, Harry was running there. I was waiting there for him a long time. Who? Harry. He…
How about this place, Mama Lou's? Did you ever play there?
